note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', user avatar

Left sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; project name header is subtracted as it is user-defined
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project path and issue number; treated as trusted navigation chrome
Right sidebar metadata -- renders: 'Assignee', 'Labels', 'Milestone', 'Due date', 'Weight', 'Time tracking', 'Lock issue', 'Participants', 'Move issue' and their associated controls

Issue header chrome -- renders: issue status, author link, action buttons ('Edit', 'Close', 'Reopen', 'Create merge request'), and description upload dropzone; issue title, description body, related issues, and discussion are subtracted
Comment form controls -- renders: 'Write', 'Preview' tabs, formatting toolbar buttons, 'Comment' and 'Comment & Close' buttons; the text input area is subtracted
